segment_contamination_dimensions: Sibling MCAT 'Swimming Pool Tensile Cover' (ID: 166772) carves out tensile cover/membrane-only flat pool covers (bubble covers, solar covers, PVC tarpaulin covers) — buyers seeking a flat pool cover rather than an overhead enclosure structure are an incompatible segment; any name or alt-name term that primarily signals a flat pool cover (e.g., 'pool cover', 'pool tarpaulin', 'bubble cover', 'solar cover') has been discarded to prevent cross-contamination.

Industrial and agricultural shed siblings (Industrial Sheds, Poultry Sheds, Cattle Sheds, Warehouse Sheds, Prefabricated Factory Shed) attract buyers with entirely different use contexts and buyer personas (industrial operators, farmers, warehouse managers vs hospitality and residential pool owners); any name term that primarily signals industrial or agricultural shed use has been excluded.
